bpf.hero.h1: What is fenugreek? Why and how to eat it for benefit?
bpf.hero.lede: Fenugreek — a seed familiar in Bangladeshi kitchens; a calm, general discussion of the question raised in the clinic's post.
bpf.intro.p1: Fenugreek is a familiar seed in our kitchens — widely used in mashed preparations, curries and pithas. The very title of this post on the clinic's Facebook page captures the curiosity many patients feel: what actually is fenugreek, and why is it eaten? This article makes some general points about the subject in a restrained way.
bpf.what.p: Fenugreek is a fibre-rich seed with a long-standing presence in Bangladeshi kitchens. From mashed fenugreek to curries, pithas, or mixing it into drinks — many kinds of use are familiar. In a general food list, it is known as part of fibre-rich foods.
bpf.h2.why: Why do some people find benefit?
bpf.why.p: Fibre-rich foods help many people's comfort in passing stool — a widely known, general experience. Some people report feeling benefit after eating fenugreek. But this experience is not the same for everyone, and there is no basis for taking it as a treatment for any disease.
bpf.h2.nottreat: Fenugreek is not a treatment for any disease
bpf.nottreat.p: The most important point: fenugreek — or any food — is not a treatment for piles, fissure, fistula or any other disease. When symptoms exist, the first step is a doctor's examination, not choosing medicines or foods on your own. Fenugreek can be eaten, but it should be seen only as one part of a healthy diet.
bpf.h2.excess: Eating too much does not suit everyone
bpf.excess.p: Moderate use and excessive use are not the same. Eating fenugreek in large amounts can increase discomfort such as gas or bloating for some people. For those below, telling the doctor before starting regular fenugreek or fenugreek-like herbal use is especially important:
bpf.excess.2: People on regular medicines — including diabetes, blood-pressure or blood-thinning medicines
bpf.excess.3: People under treatment for any long-term illness
bpf.h2.fibre: Fibre and fluids — the general rules of a healthy diet
bpf.fibre.p: Whatever fenugreek may be, fibre-rich foods and enough fluids are the general part of a healthy diet for everyone. Increasing fibre gradually and drinking water with it — these two habits help keep stool soft, which helps avoid many anorectal problems.
bpf.fibre.1: Fruits, vegetables, leafy greens and grains — increase fibre-rich foods gradually
bpf.fibre.2: Enough fluids during the day — fibre works together with water
bpf.fibre.3: Do not delay the urge to pass stool; do not sit long on the toilet straining
bpf.fibre.4: Long-standing constipation or blood with stool — not self-medication; take a doctor's advice
bpf.close.p: Fenugreek is a familiar kitchen seed — many people like using it as a fibre-rich food. But it is not a treatment for any disease, and excessive use does not suit everyone either. When symptoms of disease exist, the first and last path is a doctor's examination.
